summary: Validated Games → Appearance (Game Art Admin) end-to-end across backend + web admin UI + public web hub + mobile games hub. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases passed (list, upsert, 404/400 edges, reorder persistence, image upload+clear, admin gating, hidden exclusion). Web admin /admin/games-appearance renders 15 cards, edit→save works (toast 'Saved Mega Spin'), AI prompt row opens, sidebar 'Game Art' link under Ad Monetization navigates correctly. Public /play-and-win reflects admin label override (Featured 'Mega Spin' tile; TEST_Trivia_Blitz also shown while override live). Mobile /games (Expo web preview) shows Featured 'Mega Spin' override + QUICK GAMES + MORE GAMES sections and games-hub-page testid visible. Test data left mostly restored (spin label='Mega Spin', trivia restored to defaults). No regressions found.
critical_code_review_comments: DELETE /api/admin/game-appearance/{key}/image uses update_one WITHOUT upsert — if no override doc exists yet for that key, the clear becomes a no-op (not harmful, since image_url was already null, but inconsistent with the other mutators that upsert). Low priority.

AdminGamesAppearance.jsx is ~350 LOC and uses only testIDs: wiring looks clean. Note the 'dirty' tracker excludes image_url, which is correct because image mutations hit dedicated endpoints — behavior matches backend.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Game Art admin is wired end-to-end: backend endpoints /api/admin/game-appearance/*, /api/games/appearance; web admin at /admin/games-appearance with sidebar entry adnav-games-appearance; PlayAndWin.js on web + app/(tabs)/games.tsx on mobile both merge overrides. Did NOT exercise AI image generation (POST .../generate) in automated tests — that path hits Gemini via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY; main agent earlier confirmed it manually. Admin was previously logged in; the extra 401s in browser console are the usual pre-login fetches on route first load (/api/auth/me etc.) — not functional bugs.
